sonnet.problem: The card says "There's that line again," but no earlier card showed the words "You follow Me!". Card 12 only paraphrased that Jesus tells Peter to follow Him, and "Follow Me" is not an exact match for "You follow Me!". The callback points back to words no card has shown.
sonnet.rule: Noticing: What he points out must be true. "Same words" means an exact match. He only points back to words a card has shown.
